description: This is a PHP unit test file for the layout_utils.php utility functions in the SuiteCRM project. It contains test cases for functions such as get_form_header, get_module_title, getClassicModuleTitle, insert_popup_header, and insert_popup_footer, validating their HTML output and content.

classes.name: layout_utilsTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for layout utility functions, extending SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase. It includes multiple test methods for verifying different layout-related functions.

methods.name: testget_form_header
methods.description: Tests the get_form_header function for correct HTML output with help parameter true and false.

methods.name: testget_module_title
methods.description: Tests the get_module_title function for HTML output with show_create true and false, and different counts.

methods.name: testgetClassicModuleTitle
methods.description: Tests the getClassicModuleTitle function for correct HTML output with show_create true and false.

methods.name: testinsert_popup_header
methods.description: Tests the insert_popup_header function for HTML/JS output with includeJS true and false.

methods.name: testinsert_popup_footer
methods.description: Tests the insert_popup_footer function for output content.
